title: High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing
content:
SOP: High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing (SOP-PHM-001)
DEPARTMENT: Pharmacy
VERSION: 3.3
ROLES: pharmacist, nurse
PURPOSE: Safeguard insulin, potassium, anticoagulants, and chemotherapeutics.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of High-Alert and LASA Medication Dispensing in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Pharmacy.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
